display_name: Liberty Insurance Vietnam personal accident rules (Quy tắc bảo hiểm tai nạn con người, UW-PAG-W-001-10-V): cover, the permanent injury tables, benefits A-D, limits, exclusions, special provisions and general provisions

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md (started 2026-10-06, resumed after a usage-limit pause on 2026-10-07)

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the source rendering by tools/vnsrc.py, and in short runs checked by the same tool to occur verbatim in it. GLOSSARY.md maps every defined term and every declared type, field and constant to its Vietnamese.

source.authority: private contract terms published by the insurer; not law

scope: The whole document. Encoded: the insuring clause and payee; the operative definitions; benefits A.1 and A.2 with both permanent injury tables (60 rows as data) and every note under them; benefits B, C, D; the geographical scope (input); the limit per conveyance; limitations 1(a)-(c), 2-4; special provisions 1-9; every general exclusion limb; special exclusions 1-3, 5, 9; general provisions 1-9, 11-14, 16, 17 and conversion; regulative rules for 13(a), 14 and 16A; and the decision on a claim in three layers. Reached and refused by name: special exclusions 4 and 6. Inert: document-naming definitions, definitions never used again, special exclusions 7-8, general provisions 10 and 15, standing duties with no stated consequence. Everything the wording leaves to the summary or certificate is an input with no default. Coverage table: NOTES.md section 2 (162 rows, 0 deferred).

forks.F1: Payee on a death: a designated beneficiary, else the heirs or legal representative.
forks.F2: 'Sự kiện bảo hiểm' for 13(a): the death; the day permanence is established; otherwise the accident.
forks.F3: A 29 February birthday falls on 28 February in a common year.
forks.F5: Benefit B's 'time' in the summary is a maximum, not a qualifying minimum.
forks.F6: The left-handed swap applies to every two-column row.
forks.F8: 5 cm shortening: the 'at least about 5 cm' band; 'about' given no tolerance.
forks.F9: The remaining eye (100%) is a partial injury needing 52 weeks.
forks.F10: Death within 24 calendar months, last day included.
forks.F11: The 5% floor applies to the sum of partial items from one accident.
forks.F12: Limitation 2: the day of determination is not a day of benefit B.
forks.F13: Medical expenses: the definition's 12 months over benefit C's 52 weeks.
forks.F14: Medical expenses insured elsewhere: limitation 4's excess rule (special exclusion 3 applied to B and D only).
forks.F15: Dental surgery for an accident injury is covered (definition (b) over general exclusion 12).
forks.F17: Limitation 1(c) with no benefit A: no cap.
forks.F18: Permanent injury instalments from notice + 30 days, then 30 days apart.
forks.F19: Special provisions 3, 4 and 8 are conditions that bite (LAW art 24 alternative recorded).
forks.F20: A disappearance becomes a deemed death the day after 12 months.
forks.F21: Special provision 5 prevails over general exclusion 5(g) for sudden asphyxiation.
forks.F22: General exclusion 6(d) 'đang thực hiện công việc' read as armed forces or police on duty.
forks.F23: General exclusion 4(j): 5 km or more from shore, for surfing and sailing.
forks.F24: Exclusion limbs are engaged only by circumstances of the accident.
forks.F25: Special exclusion 8's 12-month reporting limit covers its pollution claims only.
forks.F26: Court is open from the 31st day after notice of a dispute.
forks.F27: 7(e): notice or agreement keeps cover; termination from the day of departure.
forks.F28: The injury being claimed is not a 7(f) change.
forks.F29: Cover is lost from the start of a termination day; the period's last day is covered.
forks.F30: The age limit is tested on the day in question.
forks.F31: An unpaid premium: 16B(b)'s 0,1% cap governs events before termination, not 4(b)'s nil (LAW art 27(1)(b) conflict recorded).
forks.F32: 13(c): treatment records for every benefit; timesheet and labour contract for B.
forks.F33: General provision 2's remedies as written (LAW art 22(2) conflict recorded).
forks.F34: General provision 11's subrogation clause inert (LAW arts 16(4), 38).
forks.F35: 'Within N days from day X' ends on day X + N.
forks.F37: 8B's 1.500.000 is kept on the end of the contract, not on general provision 7 refunds.
forks.F38: Short-period band edges take the lower band.
forks.F39: 13(d) applied as written (LAW arts 30, 19(3) conflict recorded).
forks.F40: The Company's payment time is not stated; not encoded (LAW art 31: 15 days).
forks.F41: 5(a)'s exception qualifies fighting and deliberate danger only.
forks.F43: 'không lắp được răng giả' qualifies the first teeth band only.
forks.F44: 5(d) applies only where the insured knew of the condition beforehand.
forks.F45: 16B(b)'s base is the benefit's schedule limit (for D, the daily allowance).
forks.F46: 'Cuối mỗi tháng' is the last calendar day of the month.
forks.F47: Benefit B's money already paid in the period is an input.
forks.F48: 1(b) within one claim treats that claim's permanent injury amount as paid.
forks.F49: Eligible from six calendar months old to age (last birthday) 65, or 80 on renewal.
forks.F50: An insured is a Vietnamese citizen or a foreigner resident in Vietnam.
